result_text:
I fixed the four default conventions so they match the files they were meant for. The new test and the existing `SourceFileFilterTest` pass (5 and 6 tests, no failures).

All changes are in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:

- **Generated HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now use `.*[.](html|htm|xhtml)`. I also removed the duplicated `html` alternative.
- **.NET documentation XML:** `.*/[.]xml` is now `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches. The `<doc>` content check is unchanged.
- **JavaScript "// Generated by":** `.*/[.]js` is now `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **Gradle JavaScript:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

Path patterns are matched against the whole path, which is why the old `/[.]` forms only matched files named literally `.js` or `.xml`.

I added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It covers each fixed rule, the still-working cases (`.html`, `.xhtml`, `build.gradle`), and that ordinary `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out. Nothing is committed.
